julia-crypto: Heads-up — planning an RBAC change for BYOK operators ahead of the key rewrap sprint next Thu. Need input on audit tagging, temporary grants, and how to avoid noisy SIEM alerts during the run.

anna-sec: Quick q — what exactly are we changing in RBAC? scope, duration, audit hooks?

julia-crypto: Proposal: create a scoped role `key-operator` (no import/create permission) that can `unwrap/rewrap` and `sign-attestation`. Grants are ephemeral (2h) via OIDC token exchange. Example minimal policy we plan to attach at grant time:

```
{
  "principal": "role:key-operator",
  "permissions": ["kms:Rewrap","kms:Decrypt","kms:SignAttestation"],
  "resource_constraints": {"key_tags": ["env:rewrap-drill"]}
}
```

We will NOT give ImportKeyMaterial or Admin privileges.

mike-sre: Two operational asks: 1) Rewrap will generate a lot of KMS API events and metric noise — can we tag these so SIEM can filter/aggregate instead of firing high-severity alerts? 2) Ensure we still preserve raw events for forensics.

julia-crypto: Agreed. Plan is to inject a drill tag on the key (`rewrap_drill=true` metadata) and include a `metadata.event_source=rewrap-drill` field in the rewrap call. Example: `kmsctl rewrap --key-id=... --tags rewrap_drill=true --meta event_source=rewrap-drill`.

sally-ops: For compliance we also need an attestation record signed by the HSM and a copy of the raw KMS audit stream. My suggestion: after rewrap batch completes, emit an attestation bundle (JSON) signed by the HSM CA, upload to secure-audit S3 with server-side encryption + KMS envelope, and publish the SHA256 to the audit index. Example flow:

1) Rewrap job writes events -> local buffered audit log
2) On job completion, generate attestation object and sign with HSM key `attest-primary`
3) `aws s3 cp attestation.json s3://secure-audit/rewrap/2026-03-25/ --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:...:attest-envelope`
4) Emit `audit:index` event with `sha256(attestation.json)` and `s3://...` pointer

anna-sec: That satisfies auditors if we maintain WORM retention and have the signature chain. We need to document revocation windows and the operator justification. Also ensure separation: the role that uploads the attestation cannot perform key material operations.

mike-sre: On SIEM suppression — I can temporarily mute specific detection rules by ID for the 3-hour window around the drill, but I will leave a low-level metric alert (rate spike) to catch any significant anomalies. I will also ensure the raw VPC flow and KMS syslog are forwarded to `secure-audit` untouched. Rule IDs I'll mute: `SIEM-KMS-002`, `SIEM-KMS-017`.

julia-crypto: Perfect. Two more edge asks: (a) If the rewrap job fails mid-batch, we must capture a partial attestation and state of the KV cache; (b) We must avoid any automated rewrap fallback that uses a different key without operator approval.

sally-ops: For (a) we'll produce a `partial_attestation` with `status:failed` and include sequence numbers for processed objects. For (b) add a hardguard: `allow-rewrap-fallback=false` in the job manifest; cluster orchestration will reject automatic fallback.

anna-sec: Before we run this in prod, let's do a tabletop on Wed 15:00 UTC (1hr) and a staging dry-run tomorrow. Please add runbook link and checklist to the calendar invite.

julia-crypto: Added invite and draft runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rewrap-sprint-v1 (comments open).

deploy-bot: Scheduled: Key rewrap sprint (ephemeral RBAC grants) — 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC. Ephemeral role duration: 2h. Post-run attestations uploaded to s3://secure-audit/rewrap/2026-03-25/. Notify: @oncall @sec-managers.

mike-sre: I'll mute the rules and set up a retention copy to secure-audit. Also will instrument an extra end-to-end test to verify attestation signature verifiable by auditors.

anna-sec: One last compliance note: retention policy must be 7 years for customer key events per our legal reqs. Sally — can you confirm S3 lifecycle + immutability?

sally-ops: Confirmed — lifecycle rule applied, object lock enabled in Compliance mode for 7y on `secure-audit` prefix. Will share lifecycle config before Wed tabletop.

julia-crypto: Great work team. I'll prepare the RBAC grant playbook (ephemeral grant + audit tag + revoke steps). Please leave comments on the runbook and flag anything we overlooked. :thumbsup:

anna-sec: :thumbsup:

mike-sre: :rocket:
